disposition_reason: Antibacterial nanomaterial study; bismuth-coated silica MIC values from 74 to 595 µg/mL in culture, not a dietary or toxicity measure.

study.method: Microdilution MIC and MBC testing of SiO2-BiNP and SiO2-AgNP composites

non_numeric_findings: Bismuth-coated silica without APTES treatment had MIC values from 74 to 595 µg/mL across tested bacteria (abstract).
Both silver and bismuth composites completely inhibited Helicobacter pylori (abstract).
